admin.label: Newsletters
admin.description: Newsletter lists, their signup and their subscribers.

permissions.manageDescription: Create, edit and delete newsletter lists, and see how many people are subscribed.
permissions.sendDescription: Schedule and send campaigns to newsletter subscribers and users.
permissions.sendImportantDescription: Send a message that reaches users even on the channels they turned off.
permissions.piiDescription: See the email addresses and phone numbers of newsletter subscribers.
permissions.subscriptionsDescription: See and change which newsletters you are subscribed to.

scopes.newslettersDescription: See and change which newsletters you get.

admin.title: Newsletters
admin.description: The lists people sign up to, their signup and their subscribers.
admin.createDescription: People sign up for it with the signup component or the HTML form on its page.
admin.deleteDescription: Its {count} subscriptions and their consent records are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteEmptyDescription: Nobody is subscribed to it yet. This cannot be undone.
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to newsletters
admin.emptyDescription: Create a newsletter, then add its signup to a page.
admin.settingsDescription: What the newsletter is called, how people get it and what they agree to.
admin.consentVersion: Version {version}. Changing the text starts a new version; each subscription keeps the version it agreed to.
admin.noSubscribersDescription: Add the signup below to a page, and subscribers show up here.
admin.embedDescription: Put the signup on a page of this site with the component, or paste the HTML form into another site.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. The signup names the newsletter by it, so changing it breaks signups that use the old one.
fields.descriptionHelp: Shown with the signup and on the account page.
fields.channelsHelp: How people can get it. SMS goes through the SMS driver the app has set up.
fields.consentTextHelp: Shown next to the consent checkbox. Changing it starts a new version, and each subscription keeps the version it agreed to.
fields.doubleOptInHelp: A new subscriber first confirms from a link in an email or SMS. Leave it on unless you collect consent elsewhere.
fields.publicHelp: Anyone can sign up through the public signup, and signed-in users see it on their account page.

form.slugRequired: Give the newsletter a URL name.
form.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

signup.name: Name
signup.phoneHelp: With the country code, such as +45.
signup.failed: You could not be signed up
signup.checkInboxDescription: We sent you a link. Confirm, and the newsletter starts coming to you.
signup.phoneInvalid: Write the phone number with its country code, such as +4512345678.
signup.channelsRequired: Pick how you want to get it.
signup.consentRequired: Tick the box to sign up.

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.description: One click, and the newsletter is on its way to you.
confirm.explanation: Confirm that you want this newsletter. You can unsubscribe from every message.
confirm.doneDescription: Every message has a link to unsubscribe again.
confirm.checkInboxDescription: We sent you a link. Open it and confirm, and the newsletter starts coming to you.
confirm.noTokenDescription: Open the link from the confirmation message again, or copy all of it into the address bar.
confirm.expiredDescription: Sign up again to get a new link.
confirm.invalid: This link does not work any more
confirm.invalidDescription: It may have been used already. Sign up again if you are not getting the newsletter.
confirm.failed: The subscription could not be confirmed

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.explanation: You will stop getting it at this address or phone number.
unsubscribe.doneDescription: You will not get it any more. You can sign up again at any time.
unsubscribe.noTokenDescription: Open the unsubscribe link from the message again, or copy all of it into the address bar.
unsubscribe.invalidDescription: Open the link from the message again, or copy all of it into the address bar.

account.title: Your newsletters
account.description: Turn a newsletter on to get it, or off to stop it.
account.unverified: Your email address is not verified yet, so we send a confirmation link before the first newsletter.
account.smsHint: Sign up for SMS with the newsletter's signup form.
account.loadFailed: Your newsletters could not be loaded
account.emptyDescription: Newsletters you can sign up for will show up here.
